## Who is Abel Sebastian?

Abel Sebastian is a startup consultant, growth operator, and ecosystem builder based in Kerala, India. He helps early-stage founders go from idea to real-world traction through strategy, execution, and ecosystem-driven growth.

He is:
- Co-Founder & Chief Business Officer at Scify Technologies Pvt Ltd
- Founder of CreateCrew
- Former Academic Intern at Kerala Startup Mission
- Former Business Development Intern at MakeMyPass
- Vice Secretary at IEEE SB UKFCET
- Creative & Operations Lead at IEDC UKFCET
- Member of IEDC NEST, IEDC Kerala

## What does Abel Sebastian offer?

### 1. Startup Consulting
- Idea validation
- Business model design
- Go-to-market (GTM) planning
- Execution roadmap

### 2. Growth Strategy & Execution
- Growth planning
- Partnerships
- Community-led acquisition
- Execution support

### 3. Hackathons & Innovation Programs
- Hackathon design and execution
- Sponsorship sourcing
- Campus engagement
- Brand positioning

## Ventures

### Scify Technologies Pvt Ltd
A multi-domain R&D company building scalable technology products and innovation ecosystems. Develops IoT and SaaS-based solutions, builds systems combining hardware, software, and cloud, and creates platforms enabling student and developer innovation.

### CreateCrew
A startup growth and execution partner helping early-stage startups achieve real traction. Designs go-to-market strategies, builds sales and outreach systems, executes hackathons and innovation programs, and enables campus-driven growth.
